notes: robots.txt checked first: only 'User-agent: *' block (huge, mostly generic disallows on tracking/checkout/duplicate-brand pages plus a long anti-spam blocklist); NO Claude-specific disallow found, so proceeded normally. Access route: direct fetch worked for all pages (no WAF encountered). Home & Living mega-menu extracted from SSR HTML of https://www.myntra.com/ (React app, but nav tree is server-rendered inline JSON under a 'shop/home-living' node). EXACT qty source: each listing page embeds 'window.__myx.searchData.results.totalCount' in the initial server-rendered HTML (this is the same backend count that drives the on-page 'N items' header and pagination) - used as primary evidence for every qty. Cross-validated additivity: summing individual Categories-facet counts (e.g. Wall Art+Wall Decor+Photo Frames+Key Holders+Windchimes+Decals=152426) exactly matched the combined multi-value filter query, and dedicated-slug pages (e.g. /mirrors, /clocks, /fountains, /wall-shelves) matched the corresponding facet value in the master Categories facet list pulled from unfiltered /home-furnishing (270 facet values) - strong confirmation these are exact, non-rounded backend counts, not marketing widgets. Nav-encoded stale filters: the nav's own URL for 'Dinnerware & Serveware' (f=Categories:Cutlery,Dining Essentials,Dinnerware,Serveware,Trays,Water Bottle) resolves to totalCount 0 for Dinnerware/Serveware/Trays/Cutlery/Dining Essentials (title falls back to generic 'Search' = no matching taxonomy value) - these facet VALUES are retired; the live/current facet names for the same product types are 'Dinner Set' and 'Serving Tray', used instead (Rule 3: retired/renamed facet, corrected to current equivalent, not silently dropped). Scope discipline: stayed within the Home & Living department nav tree (did not enumerate the other ~250 non-decor facet values in the master Categories list, e.g. Boxes/Trivet/Cake Stand/generic Bowl, even though some might be decor-adjacent, since they are not exposed anywhere in Myntra's own Home Décor navigation - only used the master facet list to get exact counts and to repair the two stale nav filter values above). Excluded whole nav branches: Bed Linen & Furnishing, Flooring, Bath (sampled 'Bathroom Accessories' - titles are mops/buckets/squeegees, not decorative, confirms exclusion), Cushions & Cushion Covers, Curtains, Furniture, Home Gift Sets, Storage (Bins/Hangers/Organisers/Laundry Bags; sampled Hooks & Holders - titles are mobile stands/organiser racks/door handles, functional not decorative, excluded), Bakeware & Cookware, Kitchen Storage & Tools, Table Covers & Furnishings, Brands, Festive Decor, Pooja Essentials (religious/devotional, treated like Holiday & Gift), Ottoman (furniture), Artificial Flowers and Plants + Garden Accessories (dropped from Plants & Planters, kept only Planters). Mixed roll-ups handled per rule (flagged null, not padded): 'Decals and Stickers' facet (26395) sampled and is dominated by self-adhesive WALLPAPER/wall stickers (excluded product type) rather than decorative wall decals, so DROPPED entirely, not just flagged. 'Wall Shelves' (dedicated /wall-shelves, 1272) sampled and mixes genuine decorative MDF wall shelves with bathroom Shower Caddies and kitchen storage racks with no site-side filter to isolate the decor-only subset - qty null+flagged. 'Candles' (Categories:Candles filter under the Home Décor mega-menu, ~5800-5900 depending on fetch time) sampled and mixes scented candles/jar candles (Home Fragrance, excluded) with plain pillar/tea-light candles (unscented decorative, included) with no available filter to split - qty null+flagged. Judgment calls documented: Cups and Mugs (56347, dedicated /cups-and-mugs) INCLUDED as tableware/drinkware per explicit scope inclusion of Tableware/dinnerware, confirmed by sampling (ceramic mugs/cup-saucer sets, not fashion merch). 'Bar & Drinkware' nav node is a mixed rollup of bar tools (openers, shakers, wine racks - excluded) and glassware (included); no dedicated Glassware node exists in Myntra's nav, so a Glassware leaf was constructed from the three glass-specific Categories facet values that are visible on the site's own filter sidebar under that node (Bar Glass 2923 + Water Glass 6718 + Decanter 22 = 9663, verified additive against the combined filter query). Photo Frames and Key Holders included as decorative wall accessories (both are explicitly grouped by Myntra itself under the 'Wall Décor' Home Décor sub-menu, not under any storage/utility menu); Photo Frames titles sampled are genuinely decorative (wood/acrylic/glass frames from home-décor brands). No room-based lighting sub-nav was found on Myntra (Lamps & Lighting is organized purely by fixture type: floor/ceiling/table/wall/outdoor/string) - all 6 fixture types traversed and included per Rule 0. Status is 'partial' rather than 'ok' because 2 of 15 leaf rows (Wall Shelves, Candles) are null+flagged out of a large in-scope catalogue, and 1 leaf (Decals and Stickers) was dropped as an out-of-scope mixed rollup rather than emitted at all.
